label: SC/APC connector pair
notes: 0.30 dB is typical for a mated SC/APC pair and 0.50 dB is the ceiling it is held to, which is IEC 61753-1 attenuation grade C (0.25 dB mean, 0.50 dB max for random mating); grade B is 0.12 dB mean and 0.25 dB max. Typical values, not one vendor's test report. The engine charges one connector per mating. Replace with the purchased connector's measured loss.
